facts.name: Shelby D. Senn
facts.assignment: County civil, small claims, all civil traffic infractions and first appearances under S-2025-58-A effective June1,2026. S-2026-27 assigns circuit service on August5,2026 only; not evidence of continuing circuit assignment.

contact.contact_note: Office/assistant shared telephone; no separate personal judicial email or fax established.

hearing_scheduling.summary: File motion before requesting time from assistant; coordinate all parties and file/serve notice. Evidentiary or extended-argument hearings require special setting.

conferral.summary: County civil discovery motions require good-faith conferral certification; coordinate hearing dates with all parties.

proposed_orders.summary: Email separate .docx proposed orders to assistant; no PDFs. Include caption, case/division, motion and service language; agreed orders indicate all-party approval.

remote_appearances.summary: Non-evidentiary civil hearings of15minutes or less permit Zoom or in-person attendance; notice must state both options. Traffic hearings are in person absent written court authorization.

chambers_communications.summary: Use assistant for scheduling and orders. No direct merits communications to judge; file legal papers with clerk.

courtesy_copies.summary: No separate general civil courtesy-copy policy established on profile; special setting required for exhibits/testimony.

small_claims_operations.summary: Pretrial attendance and subsequent in-person mediation required. Plaintiff attorneys limited to20cases per pretrial day and must email numerically sorted case list to SmallClaims@sumterclerk.com by noon the preceding day.

continuances.summary: Promptly file request; continuance is effective only upon written court order.

facts.summary: Assistant-coordinated civil hearings, emailed Word orders and short non-evidentiary hybrid appearances; small-claims docket capacity and advance case-list requirements preserved.

stated_dates.case_list_requirement: Effective immediately; calendar date not stated

review_scope.collected: Official profile HTML/text, one-page temporary assignment PDF and rendering/manual excerpt; reused county assignment order.
review_scope.content_reviewed: Contacts, practical civil scheduling, conferral, orders, appearances and small-claims docket administration; temporary assignment date visually checked.
review_scope.not_reviewed: Traffic litigation merits and first-appearance substantive procedures; basic noncivil operations only.

gaps: No fax, personal judicial email or distinct assistant-only telephone established.
